verdict.rationale: Figma exposes file data via REST/Plugin APIs (view/extract objects, layers, properties) which gives some tooling access, but Figma does not publish an open native file-format spec, and a developer explicitly reports that 'your full fidelity work is locked up in a proprietary format' with no way to keep an offline, portable local file. This directly contradicts the story's expectation of an open/documented format for portability outside the vendor's editor. Missing for 10: a documented open file-format specification, native export to a non-proprietary interchange format, and confirmation that full design fidelity (not just extracted metadata) is portable outside Figma.
